what: The table applies only to merchants with no earlier agreement: "If you have previously entered into an agreement with a Commerce entity, then 'Commerce' means that entity. If you have not previously entered into an agreement with a Commerce entity, then 'Commerce' means the entity identified in the following table"; the record's scope ("Country of Residence of Merchant: Any other jurisdiction") leaves this out, and so do Q1:31 ("Who contracts with the seller follows the seller's place") and Q1:68 ("BigCommerce's contract follows the merchant's country of residence"). The agreement is Commerce's ("between Commerce.com US, Inc. and any of Commerce's affiliates"), whose site lists "BigCommerce.com" among its products; taken here as the platform's own.
fix: Record scope: "Country of Residence of Merchant: Any other jurisdiction; for a merchant that has not previously entered into an agreement with a Commerce entity". Q1:31: "BigCommerce's table, for a merchant that has not previously entered into an agreement with a Commerce entity, runs by the merchant's country of residence down to 'Any other jurisdiction'". Q1:68: "since BigCommerce's contract, absent an earlier agreement, follows the merchant's country of residence".
